jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
From Engine Bay to Payload, we protect vital structures and systems.

Hera Technologies is a premier contract manufacturer specializing in high-precision metallic and non-metallic solutions for the Aerospace, Defense, and Space sectors. Our commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction has positioned us as an industry leader in the design, manufacturing and maintenance of thermal support systems. Our team is driven by excellence, integrity, and a passion for advancing aerospace technology.
Take the next step in your career with a company committed to excellence, where your contributions are recognized, and your potential is realized.

Role Summary:

This position leads, mentors, and grows a high-performing engineering team responsible for the design, development, and manufacturing of advanced mechanical components and assemblies for Hera Technologies’ industry-leading thermal protection systems (TPS). Operating at a senior leadership level, the Head of Engineering will drive operational excellence by managing team schedules, resource allocation, and department KPIs, while overseeing the full lifecycle from concept through production scalability. The role requires close, strategic partnership with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to champion company-wide initiatives, support business development through technical proposals and SOW generation, and ensure strict compliance with aerospace and defense standards. Ideal candidates bring 10+ years of deep technical expertise in advanced materials, composites, and ruggedized hardware, paired with a proven track record of scaling manufacturing processes, enforcing rigorous quality controls, and fostering engineering talent.
Key Responsibilities

Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering team, driving recruitment, hiring, and onboarding initiatives while managing resource allocation, team schedules, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to ensure operational excellence.
Direct the design, development, and manufacturing of mechanical components and assemblies for Hera’s industry-leading thermal protection systems (TPS), including soft goods, composites, and engineered surface finishes.
Partner closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to champion company-wide initiatives and implement scalable manufacturing and assembly processes that guarantee quality, efficiency, and strict compliance with aerospace and defense standards.
Hands on support of existing programs/projects, technical proposals, cost estimations, and statement of work (SOW) generation to support business development and capture new program opportunities in thermal protection systems and critical aerospace structures.
Oversee the creation, maintenance, and enforcement of rigorous process documentation and controls to ensure consistent production outcomes and optimize throughput across the design, prototyping, and manufacturing lifecycles.
Champion the adoption of traditional and advanced manufacturing techniques for metallics, composites, and high-temperature materials, ensuring performance, durability, and production scalability.
Drive high-level root cause analyses to investigate material failures, process anomalies, and manufacturing defects, leading the implementation of permanent corrective actions across both development and production phases.

Required Qualifications

8+ years of mechanical design and manufacturing experience, with a proven track record of managing engineering teams and technical programs focused on metallics, composites, and thermal protection systems (TPS).
Demonstrated experience hiring, mentoring, and leading high-performing engineering teams, including establishing team schedules, managing resource allocation, and tracking KPIs to drive operational success.
Proven leadership in directing major engineering projects from concept through production, involving mechanical systems, softgoods, and polymer-based components in the aerospace or defense sectors.
Deep technical expertise in thermal protection systems, composite manufacturing processes, material properties, and relevant aerospace testing standards, with the ability to provide detailed-level engineering guidance.
Experience supporting business development initiatives, including assisting with technical proposals, cost estimations, and statements of work (SOW).
Strong background overseeing the creation of manufacturing and build plans, rigorous process documentation, and quality controls to ensure compliance with aerospace and defense industry standards.
Strategic understanding of CAD workflows, advanced prototyping, and fabrication techniques (such as machining, composite layups, and bonding) to effectively manage engineering throughput.
Deep knowledge and experience of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to track inventory, manage bills of materials (BOMs), and streamline production and engineering workflows.
Expertise leading root cause analyses and implementing corrective actions for complex material failures, process anomalies, and manufacturing defects.
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field; an advanced degree (Master's or MBA) is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

Strategic oversight of CAD/CAM workflows and product lifecycle management (PLM) systems to effectively manage engineering data, configuration control, and production workflows across the department.
Deep expertise in GD&T principles (per ASME Y14.5) with the ability to review, approve, and establish corporate standards for aerospace-grade engineering drawings.
Extensive background directing advanced design and manufacturing methodologies across CNC machining, composites, ceramics, sheet metal, and injection molding, including tooling and mold development.
Proven ability to foster high-level cross-functional alignment, seamlessly collaborating with manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and program management to drive company initiatives.
Demonstrated experience overseeing qualification and certification campaigns for aerospace and defense hardware, including ruggedized systems and TPS components.
Strong technical leadership in design methodologies for harsh environments, ensuring team deliverables meet strict requirements for durability, thermal resilience, and mechanical integrity.
Active U.S. Security Clearance (Secret or higher), or the ability to obtain and maintain one, to oversee controlled defense-related programs and secure facilities.
PhD. or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field, combined with extensive leadership experience in advanced material applications.

Additional Requirements

Ability to work in office, lab, and manufacturing environments with occasional exposure to noise, dust, and temperature variations.
Must be able to lift and carry up to 35 lbs and perform tasks involving standing, walking, bending, and manual assembly.
Visual acuity required for reading technical drawings, inspecting components, and operating precision instruments.
May require use of PPE such as safety glasses, gloves, and hearing protection, in accordance with Cal/OSHA safety standards.
Occasional travel to supplier or test sites, including outdoor or industrial settings, with adherence to company and OSHA safety protocols.
Must have professional working proficiency reading, writing, and speaking English.

Job Details

FLSA Classifications: Salary (Exempt)
Type: Full Time
Business Hours: Core (flexibility to support project needs beyond standard times)
Salary Range: $120,000 to $170,000
Reports to: VP of Engineering
Base Location: Irvine, CA
Travel: Up to 10%
Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.
Total compensation will also include a comprehensive set of benefits including but not limited to: Company paid employee medical, dental and vision insurance. 401K company match (eligibility required), paid sick leave, paid vacation, paid holidays and discretionary bonuses.
EXPORT CONTROL REQUIREMENTS:

To conform to US Government export regulations, the applicant must be a (i) US Citizen, (ii) lawful permanent resident of the U.S. (aka green card holder), (iii) protected individual as defined by U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or (iv) eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

jobs.description:
About The National Hockey League

Founded in 1917, the National Hockey League (NHL®) is the premier professional ice hockey league in the world, and is one of the major professional sports leagues in the United States and Canada.

With more than 1500 employees across the US and Canada, the NHL is a global sports and entertainment organization committed to building healthy and vibrant communities using the sport of hockey.

At the NHL, we are looking for dynamic, energetic and impactful individuals who are committed to doing the same by sharing in our philosophy that Hockey is for Everyone – and inclusion belongs on the ice, in the locker rooms, boardrooms and stands.

Summary

WHAT WE EXPECT OF YOU

We are seeking an experienced Director of Software Engineering with strong expertise in API design and relational database modeling to join our team. You will be responsible for designing and implementing high-performance backend services and RESTful APIs that power our consumer-facing and internal applications. This role requires both technical excellence and leadership skills to mentor team members and drive architectural decisions.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Backend Development

Develop high-performance, scalable backend services using Java
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
Design and implement caching strategies for optimal performance
Build robust error handling and logging mechanisms
Ensure proficiency in unit and integration testing
Deep understanding of native mobile and web multi-tiered, distributed applications.

API Design & Development

Design and implement RESTful APIs following industry best practices and standards
Create comprehensive API specifications using OpenAPI/Swagger
Ensure API consistency, versioning strategies, and backward compatibility
Implement and integrate OAuth 2.0 and SAML-based authentication
Establish and maintain API design guidelines and patterns for the engineering team
Understanding how to leverage CDNs for API scale/optimization (e.g., Cloudflare)
Carefully craft API inputs/outputs to maximize CDN cache hit ratios
Utilize API testing frameworks to ensure reliability and performance
Experience with API performance monitoring and optimization

Leadership

Mentor junior developers on API design principles and data modeling best practices
Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback
Lead technical design discussions and architectural decisions
Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing
Collaborate with operational counterparts on observability metrics

Qualifications

Knowledge Areas/Experience

Required

8+ years of backend development experience with at least 3 years focused on API design
Strong understanding of RESTful principles, HTTP protocols, and web standards
Proven track record of designing scalable, maintainable APIs

Preferred

Experience with Apache Cayenne ORM framework (https://cayenne.apache.org/)
Experience with Agrest REST API framework (https://agrest.io/)
Knowledge of API gateway patterns and service mesh concepts
Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Bamboo, Kubernetes)
Experience with data processing and analysis frameworks like Apache Spark Data Frame API, DFLib
Familiarity with event-driven architectures
Contributions to open-source projects
Experience programming/scripting with Python
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS), S3, Kinesis, Dynamo
Apache Flink

Education/Certifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience

Required Technical Skills

Java: Strong proficiency in Java development with experience building enterprise-grade applications
MySQL: Hands-on experience with MySQL (v. 8.0 and above), including performance optimization and query tuning
Data Modeling: Proven experience with relational database design and data modeling best practices
Git: Proficiency with Git version control, including branching strategies, merge conflict resolution, and collaborative workflows
Maven: Strong experience with Maven for build automation, dependency management, and project lifecycle management
Bamboo: Experience with Atlassian Bamboo for continuous integration and deployment pipelines
JAX-RS: Expertise in building RESTful web services using JAX-RS
Jackson API: Proficiency with Jackson for JSON processing and serialization
POJO: Experience working with Plain Old Java Objects and understanding of object-oriented design principles

Additional Skills

Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

CORE COMPETENCIES

These core competencies reflect the underlying values that are necessary to represent the National Hockey League:

Accountability
Adaptability
Communication
Critical Thinking
Inclusion
Professionalism
Teamwork & Collaboration

The NHL offers U.S. regular, full-time employees:

Time to Recharge
: Utilize our generous Paid Time Off (PTO) to focus on your well-being and ensure a healthy work/life balance. PTO includes paid holidays, vacation, personal and sick days, plus an extra day off for your birthday.

Ability to Focus on your Health:
Along with competitive salaries, the NHL offers comprehensive health benefits to employees and their eligible dependents effective on their first day with us – there is no waiting period. The NHL subsidizes a large portion of the health benefits costs, therefore your cost for medical, dental and vision coverage is minimal.

We also offer our employees and members of their household access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) to support mental, physical, and financial health. In addition, employees have access to a digital wellness resource designed to improve health and happiness through courses in sleep, movement, and focus. These services are confidential and at no-cost to our employees.

Childcare Leave:
Because your family is the NHL family, employees are offered comprehensive Childcare Leave to welcome your new addition. The primary caregiver to the child is entitled to up to 12 weeks of paid Childcare Leave, at full pay, following the birth, adoption, or placement of a child.

Employees that are not the primary caregiver to the child are entitled to up to 6 weeks of paid Childcare Leave, at full pay, which must be taken within the first 6 months following the birth, adoption, or placement of a child.

Confidence in your Retirement Goals:
Participate in the NHL’s Savings Plan which includes a 401K (pre-tax and Roth options) plus non-elective (employer) contributions to keep your retirement goals on track.

A Hybrid Work Schedule
: The NHL recognizes the value of flexibility in work locations/schedules to help our employees balance work/life priorities. Hybrid work schedules are available for a majority of our roles.

Our New Headquarters:
Our new, state of the art, offices are located at One Manhattan West in Hudson Yards. When you’re in the office, you can conduct meetings in one of our high-tech conference rooms, have lunch with a view or play in the game room. Employees can also enjoy New York’s newest neighborhood that is home to more than 100 shops, culinary experiences, and public artwork.

A Savings for Commuting:
Participate in the NHL’s pre-tax commuter benefit plan which helps offset the financial cost of traveling to and from our office.

NHL Partner Rates:
Unlock exclusive pricing from our Partners that include savings on travel, consumer goods and services, plus the NHL Store.

Life at the NHL:
In your first few days, you meet with your new teammates and the HR Team. You have the opportunity to learn more about the NHL and our workplace culture. Employees are invited to play hockey during our Tuesday Night Skate at Chelsea Piers, join our Employee Resource Groups and more. You are a part of our team and we encourage you to be your authentic self, adding to our dynamic workplace culture.

SALARY RANGE:

$160-180K

Actual base pay for a successful candidate will be determined based on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to: experience/training, market demands, and geographic location.

When applying, please be sure to include a cover letter with your salary expectations for this role. We thank all applicants for their interest in this opportunity, however only qualified candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. NO EMAILS OR PHONE CALLS PLEASE.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Head of Application Engineering and Productionization
jobs.description:
Role Summary

The AI Acceleration (AIA) function within the Chief Marketing Office (CMO) is the business-led team that owns the design, delivery, and scale-up of priority AI capabilities across Commercial. AIA works in tight collaboration with various Pfizer functions to deploy and maintain production-grade AI solutions that simplify how we work and drive measurable value across all processes.

The Senior Director of Application Engineering & Productionization is responsible for translating strategic priorities into the delivery of scalable, secure, enterprise‑grade applications and AI/ML solutions. This role leads large, multi‑disciplinary technology teams to design, and build high‑quality systems with a strong emphasis on execution, reliability, and continuous improvement. The leader establishes robust engineering standards—including architecture, CI/CD, testing, and observability—to ensure consistent delivery and production excellence. Success in this role requires guiding teams through ambiguity, developing senior engineering talent, and partnering closely with product, platform, data, and operations stakeholders to align technical decisions with business outcomes while effectively communicating trade‑offs and progress to senior leadership.

Role Responsibilities

Strategy & architecture

Define the overall strategy and governance model for application engineering and productionization, establishing frameworks, patterns, and standards for how AI and digital products are built, deployed, and maintained
Make architectural decisions on front-end, full-stack, cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), and CI/CD pipelines, to ensure scalability, performance, and security
Partner with the Heads of Agent Product Management, Data Engineering, and Data Strategy to maintain consistent architecture, shared infrastructure, and unified engineering standards across AIA

Build & ship (governance level)

Oversee the design, development, and rollout of applications and tools used across AIA pods, with a focus on reuse and maintainability
Lead front-end and full-stack development teams in implementing secure, scalable interfaces and integrations with enterprise systems and APIs
Establish and govern CI/CD pipelines, release management, and environment configuration for applications and maintain alignment with security and quality standards
Collaborate with agent and AI/ML engineering teams to move AI/ML models into production with strong deployment, versioning, and monitoring practices

Quality & reliability

Define quality standards and performance metrics for applications covering uptime, latency, reliability, and user experience
Oversee the implementation of automated testing, logging, and observability platforms to ensure operational excellence
Establish mechanisms for proactive issue detection, incident response, and continuous improvement of application stability and security

Team & culture

Build and lead a high-performing engineering organization (~30 FTEs, hundreds of contractors) across front-end, full-stack, DevOps, and architecture disciplines
Set strong technical direction, review design and code, and mentor senior engineers and engineering managers to raise the organizational engineering bar
Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning, emphasizing reusable components, automation, and engineering rigor

Cross-functional impact

Partner with Data Engineering, Product, Agent Product Management, and Platform Ops teams to ensure seamless integration of applications with data pipelines, APIs, and orchestration frameworks
Work with the Data Strategy & Performance team to align engineering practices with enterprise governance, security, and compliance requirements
Maintain close feedback loops with users and stakeholders to shape application roadmaps based on adoption, performance, and business impact
Communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, and implications clearly to senior leadership, connecting architecture and engineering choices to business outcomes

Innovation & best practices

Promote adoption of modern software development methodologies and tooling, including agile delivery, DevOps, and continuous delivery frameworks
Stay current on emerging trends in application engineering, AI integration, and cloud infrastructure, applying these insights to strengthen engineering practices and drive innovation

Basic Qualifications

Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required; Master’s degree strongly preferred.
12+ years of relevant professional experience.
Proven people‑leadership experience, with a track record of building and developing high‑performing teams.
Experience working within regulated industries (e.g., pharmaceuticals, banking, insurance).
Demonstrated ability to navigate and influence within large, complex organizations.
Strong stakeholder‑management capabilities, with success driving alignment across diverse functions and seniority levels.
Recognized industry thought leader with enterprise‑wide strategic impact.
Demonstrated program and operations management expertise, particularly within large, regulated environments.
Proven success managing quality standards, leading efficient development teams, and optimizing complex staffing and resource allocation models.
Deep expertise in cross‑functional integration and operational effectiveness within a large corporate ecosystem.

Ability to travel based on business needs
NOT eligible for Relocation Package
This position is hybrid and requires working onsite 2 to 3 days per week

Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage.
